items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: we all auditioned the same day to do this week in the Apollo with Machito's Latin band

ctx.x: Well, every relief band in New York at the time, no matter where you were working. If you were working at a big night club, it was a Latin band. So you had to hear 'em. And, gradually, you heard things that you liked and Machito, he was the first one to actually blend jazz. Because Mario, the trumpet player, he was like the musical

director of the band; he used to be with Chick Webb. He was a trumpet player in Chick Webb's band. So natrually he had that jazz feeling in him. And I know at one time, they were doing the Apollo, Machito, then they would have a jazz saxophonist with 'em. I remember one day, who was that there...I auditioned and Stan Getz auditioned and, I think it was Brew Moore, we all auditioned the same day to do this week in the Apollo with Machito's Latin band. That's how popular the marriage became at that particular time.…
first came here. Like you get off the bandstand, playin' them shows, Ethel Waters and the chorus girls and what not and then the Latin band would come on. And I liked the music; it's pretty music.
